items.text: 37. O Allah, I ask of you to grant me taufeeq (ability) like that of the people of guidance, actions like that of the people of yaqeen (conviction), sincerity like those who repent for their sins, courage like those who make sabr (patience), sacrifice like those who have fear, aspirations as posessed by those who are endowed with Your love, ibaadat (worship) like that of the pious and recognition like that of the

Ulama. And allow all of these (blessings) to remain with me till I meet with You. O Allah, I beg of You to bless me with such fear which would prevent me from committing sins so that I may do acts of obedience for You in a way that I will receive Your pleasure, and I may repent earnestly before You out of fear for You, that I may be encouraged to do acts of worship out of special regards for You, and I may rely purely on You in all matters and hope for the best from You, O The Unblemished Creator of light
38. O Allah, do not cause us to die a sudden death, nor seize us by surprise nor make us unmindful of any duty or advice
39. O Allah, make me feel comfortable in the loneliness of the grave
40. O Allah, have mercy on me through the blessings of the Holy Qur-aan and make it

40. Ihyaul a guide for me, a source of light, a source of guidance and a source of mercy as well. O Allah, make me remember what I have forgotten of the Holy Qur-aan, and grant me an understanding of those parts which I am ignorant about
Enable me to recite it during the hours of the night and day and make it a proof for me, O Rabb of the worlds
41. O Allah, I am Your servant and the son of Your servant, the son of Your bondswoman. I am always within Your grasp, my movements are under Your control,

I testify to meeting You, I believe in Your promise. You commanded me but I disobeyed You. You prohibited me (from doing certain things) but I did not restrain myself. Here is a person who is begging You for safety from the Fire of Hell. There is no deity besides You. You are most pure. I have wronged my soul, please forgive me as You alone can forgive sins
42. O Allah, all praise is due to You, and before You do I present my complaints
You alone do I ask for help and help is sought from You only There is no power or strength except through Allah Ta’ala
43. O Allah, I beg of You through Your Messenger, Muhammad ,
43. Al-La-’aalil Masnoo’ah

Your friend Ibraaheem , Musa who had the privilege of speaking to you privately, Isa , Your Rooh (spirit) and Your Word; the book of Musa , the Injeel of Isa , the Zaboor of Dawood and the Holy Qur-aan of Nabi Muhammad and from every revelation which

You sent (from time to time), from every decision You have passed and by virtue of every such person whose request you have granted, or every poor person whom You have enriched, or every rich person whom You have reduced to poverty, or every misguided person whom You have guided. I beg of You through Your name which You revealed to

Musa , and I beg of you, Your name which You placed on the earth, so it became steady, which You placed on the heavens and they became stationary, which You placed on the mountains and they became firmly grounded. I beg of You through Your name whereby Your Throne (Arsh) is stable, and through

Your pure and clean name which is revealed in Your Book and through Your name which You placed on the day and it brightened, and on the night so it became dark, and through Your greatness, glory and the noor (radiance) of Your countenance that You bless me with the Holy Qur-aan so that it permeates my flesh, my blood, my hearing and my seeing. Grant me through Your power the ability that I may act upon it as I have no ability or strength except from You
44. I begin with the name of Allah who is full of grandeur, sound arguments and overpowering might. Whatever He willed has happened. I seek the protection of Allah from the accursed Devil
45. O Allah, bless me at the time of my death and (bless me) in what follows after death
Recite the above dua 25 times daily. (Read this dua twenty-five times daily)
46. O Allah, do not make us fearless of Your secret planning, let not Your remembrance die out from our hearts, do not remove Your covering over our faults and do not make us from the unmindful
47. O Allah, I seek Your protection from narrowness (distress) in this world and on the Day of Judgement
48. O Allah, I beg of You the hastening of ease and comfort upon me, the removal of afflictions and leaving this world towards Your mercy
49. O The One who suffices (us) from everyone else and the One from whom none can be self-sufficient

O The Being who is One and has no equal. O the One who does not need any support and is a support for everyone else, all hopes have been cut off except from You. Give me salvation from the situation in which I am and help me in the affliction that I find myself in, through Your benevolence and by virtue of the of Nabi Muhammad on You. Aameen!

50. O Allah, take care of me through Your eyes which never sleep, embrace me with Your strength from which no one can be seperated and have mercy on me through Your power so that I may not be destroyed. (O Allah) You are my only hope. How many gifts have You showered upon me for which I was deficient in offering gratitude to You. Many were the occasions on which You tested me and I was found lacking in patience. O the One who did not deprive me of His Grace despite my ungratefulness, who did not disgrace me in spite of my impatience and who witnessed my sins but did not expose them. O the One who is full of everlasting goodness that never ends and O You who distributes favours that cannot be counted,
I beg of You to shower Your blessings on Nabi Muhammad and his progeny
O Allah, with Your help do we repel our enemies and oppressors

O Allah, assist me in my Deen through this world, and in my hereafter through piety, look after my affairs which are hidden from me and do not leave me alone to deal with those affairs which are before me. O the One whom the sins of the creation cannot harm and who loses nothing by forgiving, favour me with that which does not cause You any loss (i.e., forgiveness) and forgive me from what does not cause You any harm (i.e. sins). Verily You are a Generous Giver. O Allah I beg of You for an instant solution in every calamity, remarkable patience, abundant sustenance and safety from all trials and I beg of You for perfect and lasting ease and the ability to be grateful for it and I beg of You for total independence from others. There is no ability or strength in us except with the help of Allah, Most High and most Great
O my Rabb, O my Rabb, O my Rabb
